settings.title: Rampage, but righteous
settings.text: Every barred window you break lets somebody walk out. The score that matters is the one marked FREED.

settings.title: Ten storeys of concrete
settings.text: Facilities crumble floor by floor. Knock the supports out and the whole structure comes down on itself.

settings.title: Fill the meter, breathe fire
settings.text: Smashing builds RAGE. Cash it in for a few seconds of invulnerable, fire-breathing demolition.

settings.heading: Kwadzilla
settings.intro: They built the whole island out of concrete and razor wire. They did not plan for something forty feet tall with a bad attitude. Climb the walls, pull the place apart, and get everybody off the rock.
settings.reward_note: One use per customer. Applies at checkout.
settings.footnote: Kwadzilla is a work of arcade fiction. Every facility, tower and logo in the game is invented for the game. No real place, company or person is depicted.
